title: Sam and the Ham
lines: Dad had a big ham in a pan.
Sam is a cat. Sam is a bad cat.
Sam sat on a mat and had a nap.
The ham is hot. Sam ran to the pan.
Sam had a bit and ran!
Dad is mad at Sam. Bad cat!
Sam hid in a bag. Sam sat and sat.
Dad had jam and a bun.
Sam ran to Dad and sat on his lap.
Dad pats Sam. Sam has a nap.

questions.ask: What did Sam take from the pan?
questions.listenFor: A bit of the ham. It is said in the story. If they are stuck, read that line again and stop right before the answer.
In a bag. Have them find the word bag on the page and touch it - proving it beats remembering it.

questions.ask: Do you think Dad stayed mad at Sam? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer. Listen for a reason from the story - Dad patted Sam, or Sam sat on his lap. The because is what you are after.
